title: Skill evidence policy (contract version 1)
description: What a skill requires before it may conclude: the axes it needs evidence on, from which sources, how fresh, and what it does without them. Lives next to the skill in this repository; the runtime applies it at the receiving seam. See findings/EVIDENCE.md section Skill policy.

sources.description: Source systems whose evidence satisfies this axis (the skill's trusted authority for it).

insufficient_evidence.description: The only legal value. A skill may never declare that a missing axis is assumed; it answers partial and names the gap.
